subject: cardboardRobot
pitch:
Category: Humanoid character.
Subject: kid in a cardboard-box robot costume.
Style: cardboard craft.

spec.name: Cardboard Robo-Kid
spec.description: A kid in a homemade cardboard robot costume: a taped-up kraft box torso with drawn dials and a bottle-cap jetpack, a box helmet with the kid's real face peeking through a cutout window, cardboard tube arms with box mitts, and craft boots.
spec.layout: A stylized kid stands centred on x=0 facing +Z, feet on y=0. The visible kid is short: legs (y 0.14-0.62) in denim pants and cardboard craft boots, then the big cardboard box torso (y 0.56-1.38, half-width 0.44, half-depth 0.30) that dwarfs the body, then the box helmet (y 1.38-1.88, half-size 0.26) with one antenna on top reaching y 2.17. Arms run from shoulder holes at [±0.45, 1.18] angled down and slightly out to wristL/wristR at [±0.76, 0.72], ending in chunky box mitts beside the hips. From the front: the helmet's cutout window shows the kid's real face (eyes, brows, blush, smile, hair fringe), the torso front carries a drawn dial gauge, three round buttons, a red paper heart and a scribbled name label over a central tape seam. The back carries a cardboard jetpack with two yellow-banded booster cylinders. Cardboard-craft style on every part: kraft box surfaces with kraftDark corrugated strips along every cut edge, tan tape seams and collars, silver brad rivets at corners, and hand-drawn ink marker doodles.

parts.builds: The big cardboard box torso the kid wears. The box spans x -0.44..0.44, y 0.56..1.38, z -0.30..0.30, built as kraft panels with kraftPale inner faces, kraftDark corrugated strips (thin fluted strips, ~0.025 wide) along every edge, and a tape seam: a vertical tape strip ~0.06 wide down the centre of the front face from y 0.56 to 1.38. Front panel details, all seated on the front face z 0.30: a paper dial gauge (white circle r 0.11 centred [-0.15, 1.08], an ink ring, yellow tick marks, an ink needle pointing to one red tick, a small ink pivot dot); a vertical row of three round buttons (cylinders r 0.035 protruding 0.03, small silver bases, ink outline rings) in red, yellow, green from top to bottom at [0.20, 1.16 / 1.02 / 0.88]; a red paper heart ~0.09 tall at [-0.15, 0.84]; a white paper label plate 0.2 x 0.07 at [0.16, 0.72] with three short ink scribble strokes as marker writing. Silver brad rivets (discs r 0.012) at the corners of every face. Side arm holes centred at the shoulderL and shoulderR mounts (hole r 0.09) with tape rims; the arm parts plug into these. Back: a kraft back plate (~0.5 x 0.55) on z -0.30..-0.34 carrying a jetpack of two kraft cylinders (r 0.09, centred [±0.16, 0.92, -0.38], length 0.24 along z) each with a yellow band, a kraftDark nozzle cone at its lower end, and small ink doodles; reach no further back than z -0.52. A tape collar ring around the top opening at the neckHole mount. Add a small corrugated flap on the top face.
parts.attaches: Worn over the legs part: the box bottom (y 0.56) hangs over the pants at legL and legR. The helmet rests on the top face at neckHole. The arms root in the side arm holes at shoulderL and shoulderR; their tape rims meet the torso's hole rims.

parts.builds: The kid's cardboard robot helmet. The box spans x -0.26..0.26, y 1.38..1.88, z -0.27..0.27 in kraft, with kraftDark corrugated strips along every edge, a tape rim band around the bottom (meeting the torso collar at neckHole), silver brad rivets at the corners of each face, and two kraft side bolts (cylinders r 0.04 sticking out at [±0.26, 1.66, 0.06]) with ink rings around their bases. On the front face, a rounded window 0.30 wide x 0.24 tall centred [0, 1.63, 0.27] with a kraftDark cut edge, through which the kid's real face shows: a skin face plane just inside at z 0.245; two white eye ovals (~0.05 x 0.06) at [±0.08, 1.65, 0.252] with ink pupils, small white glints and thin ink lash lines; ink brows at y 1.70; blush ovals (~0.035) at [±0.10, 1.60]; a small skin nose bump at [0, 1.62, 0.26]. The lower face below y 1.575 (chin and mouth area, a rounded skin piece filling the window's bottom) is built as a separate piece riding the jaw joint so the smile can open, with an ink smile line on it. Hair-coloured fringe tufts (3-4 small pointed flaps in hair) hang over the window's top edge from y 1.74 down to ~1.71. A thin antenna (rod r 0.008) rises from [0, 1.88, 0] to y 2.12 with a red ball (r 0.045) on top and a tape wrap at its base. Nothing else covers the face window.
parts.attaches: Sits on the torso box's top face at the neckHole mount, its bottom tape rim meeting the torso's tape collar.

parts.builds: The left cardboard tube arm with a box mitt, reading as a kid's arm in a costume sleeve. Upper arm tube (r 0.07, kraft) from the shoulderL mount [0.45, 1.18, 0.02] to elbowL [0.65, 0.98, 0.02]; forearm tube (r 0.065, kraft) from elbowL down to wristL [0.76, 0.72, 0.03]. At the shoulder end: a tee-coloured sleeve ring (r 0.085, short) showing the kid's t-shirt inside the arm hole, capped by a tape rim. At the elbow: a kraftDark corrugated ring (short cylinder r 0.075 with flutes). At the wrist: a tape cuff. The mitt is a kraft box 0.2 x 0.2 x 0.16 centred [0.78, 0.62, 0.03] with kraftDark corrugated edge strips, a small thumb lump (box ~0.05) on the body-facing side, and three short ink knuckle lines drawn on its front face; it rides the wristL joint. Everything derives from the shoulderL, elbowL and wristL joints.
parts.attaches: Roots in the torso box's left arm hole at the shoulderL mount; its tape rim meets the torso's hole rim.

parts.builds: The right cardboard tube arm with a box mitt, mirroring armL: upper arm tube (r 0.07, kraft) from the shoulderR mount [-0.45, 1.18, 0.02] to elbowR [-0.65, 0.98, 0.02]; forearm tube (r 0.065, kraft) down to wristR [-0.76, 0.72, 0.03]. Tee-coloured sleeve ring and tape rim at the shoulder end, kraftDark corrugated ring at the elbow, tape cuff at the wrist. The mitt is a kraft box 0.2 x 0.2 x 0.16 centred [-0.78, 0.62, 0.03] with kraftDark corrugated edge strips, a small thumb lump on the body-facing side, three ink knuckle lines on its front face, riding wristR. Everything derives from the shoulderR, elbowR and wristR joints.
parts.attaches: Roots in the torso box's right arm hole at the shoulderR mount; its tape rim meets the torso's hole rim.

parts.builds: The kid's legs and boots under the box, the only part touching the floor. Two denim pants tubes (r 0.07) from under the box bottom at the legL and legR mounts [±0.2, 0.57, 0] down to y 0.14, each with a white sock band (~0.03 tall) at y 0.16 above the boot. Cardboard craft boots: kraft boxes 0.22 wide x 0.13 tall x 0.32 deep centred [±0.2, 0.065, 0.06], standing on y 0, each with a sole slab in sole (0.24 x 0.02 x 0.34 at y 0.01), a kraftDark corrugated strip along the toe edge, three ink lace crosses drawn on the front of the boot, a tape strap around the ankle, and a small red paper patch (~0.04) with an ink doodle on the outer side of each boot. Rides the hipL/kneeL/footL and hipR/kneeR/footR joints.
parts.attaches: Emerges from under the torso box bottom at the legL and legR mounts, the pant tops tucking inside the box's lower edge.
